purpose: Teach: 借地/集成/私有/兼業/満了/抹消/協約/家主

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、駐車場の借地契約を更新しろ
lines.en: Renew the parking lot lease agreement.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. Direct eye contact. Each clause lands with weight. No inflection—this is settled fact, not discussion. Authoritative exhale.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様の評判を集成した資料を作成しました
lines.en: Yes. I've prepared a summary of feedback from our valued clients.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgement, steady delivery. Slight lift on the confirmation. Professional but warm—showing competence without overstepping. Even pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、私有施設を社員に開放しろ
lines.en: Open the company's private facilities to our staff.
lines.style: Same firmness as before. Measured tempo. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard. A pause before speaking, then unwavering clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の兼業申請を整理しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm currently processing the staff side-employment applications.
lines.style: Clear status report, attentive to detail. Steady rhythm. Slight forward lean in posture—engaged, showing progress. Neither rushed nor hesitant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、取引契約の満了前に再交渉しろ
lines.en: Renegotiate the client contracts before they expire.
lines.style: Sharp, purposeful. Each word distinct. The tone of foresight—protecting position ahead of deadline. Quick tempo. Minimal breath between clauses.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い顧客データを抹消する手続きを進めています
lines.en: Yes. I'm moving forward with the process of clearing our old customer records.
lines.style: Measured confirmation, methodical in pacing. Demonstrates initiative and care with sensitive data. Quiet confidence. Professional closure without overselling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界協約を遵守しろ
lines.en: Ensure the company adheres to industry standards.
lines.style: Resolute, final-sounding. Low pitch, steady breath. The voice of someone setting non-negotiable terms. A beat of silence after—this is the standard, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。家主との家賃交渉を進めております
lines.en: Yes. I'm currently in discussions with the landlord about the rental terms.
lines.style: Final confirmation with quiet assurance. Slightly softer than previous updates—this one is handled, tension managed. Breath settles. Closing note.
